taxonomic_note: Accepted species, but Central Texas records require modern separation from Quercus fusiformis; older broad live-oak labels are not transferred automatically.
look_here_first: Compare leaf breadth, lower-surface pubescence, acorn shape, geography, and Q. fusiformis overlap. Ambiguous Central Texas live oaks should remain unresolved.

project_inclusion.target_zone_status: UNRESOLVED TAXON CONCEPT — USER APPROVED LEARNER INCLUSION
project_inclusion.range_basis: No qualifying project target-zone county is currently locked under strict Q. virginiana. Bell evidence is outside the project target list; many Central Texas live-oak records may represent Q. fusiformis or intermediates.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: typical acorns broadly ovoid to barrel-shaped with blunt or rounded apex
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Q. fusiformis is the priority comparison; geography plus acorn and leaf morphology matters more than any one trait.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Strict Q. virginiana cannot be assigned from a generic live-oak label.

photo_note: Modern-concept comparison imagery remains high priority.
